work: Migrated the hidden mono-attraction Lienzer Bergbahnen legacy Park and its Osttirodler parkItem to a published standalone Alpine coaster; imported one exact credited photograph and published its Facebook announcement.
qualification: Lienzer Bergbahnen is a cableway and mountain recreation operator rather than a structured amusement park. Its hidden Park fiche contained only the Osttirodler item. The operator sells an Osttirodler-only ticket as well as a separate lift-and-ride ticket. Official editor searches found the hidden legacy Park but no Osttirodler standalone. The controlled migration marked the hidden legacy Park and item NotRelevant without deletion.

officialFacts.seasonStateOn2026-11-15: 2026 summer season ended; all operator lifts listed closed

sourceLimitations: The operator shows the 2026 summer season ended and no future Osttirodler dates. The ride is temporarily closed; no weekly schedule or active public price was invented.
The operator’s 2026 tariffs are retained below for future verification only, not offered as current fares during closure.
Legacy openingDate 2010-01-01 was a false precise date. A historical report confirms construction in 2010 but not the exact opening day, so openingDate was cleared.
The legacy item length was 2800 m; the operator describes a 2.7 km descent. The native length was corrected to the official value.
The Commons photograph dates from June 2016. It shows the exact track, but not its current appearance.
The legacy Park and parkItem remain hidden and NotRelevant. No destructive deletion was requested or performed.
